description: Currently active concept alerts. Two rules: `big_move` (|pct_change| > 3%) and `limit_up_cluster` (limit_up_count >= 3 AND stock_count >= 5). Cheap, non-billable. Use as the agent's signal for 'which themes are running hot right now'. With `kind=industry`, only `big_move` ever fires — a Shenwan level-1 industry holds 150+ members, so the limit-up cluster rule would trigger nearly every day and drown the feed.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

kind.description: Dimension: concept (hot-theme library, default), base (broad base labels), or industry. All use independent chain-linked equal-weight indices with base 1000. A stored theme membership alone does not establish current trading activity; use concept_tags for current status.

name: concepts_alerts
